preconditions.description: The number of packages to be installed in each test case is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: Each package name is a string of up to 40 characters, using the English alphabet, digits, _, -, ., and +.
preconditions.description: The characters allowed in package names are specified.

preconditions.expression: Each package has at most 20 dependencies.
preconditions.description: The maximum number of dependencies for any package is 20.

preconditions.expression: Each dependency is one of the other n-1 packages.
preconditions.description: Dependencies are always other packages in the same test case.

preconditions.expression: Input ends when n is zero.
preconditions.description: The input terminates when the number of packages to be installed is zero.

postconditions.expression: Output the order of package installation.
postconditions.description: The output must provide a valid order in which all packages can be installed, respecting their dependencies.

postconditions.expression: Output 'cannot be ordered' if the packages cannot be ordered.
postconditions.description: If there is no valid order due to cyclic dependencies or other reasons, the output must indicate this.

postconditions.expression: Output is lexicographically first if multiple orders are possible.
postconditions.description: If there are multiple valid orders, the output must be the lexicographically first one.

postconditions.expression: Output is given for each test case.
postconditions.description: Each test case must have its own output line, separated by a blank line from the next.
